purpose: Teach: 相模原/小嶋/佐原/文京/原画/沢田/クイック/壇上

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、神奈川県相模原のJAXA見学行ったろ
lines.en: Riku—you went to see the JAXA space center in Sagamihara, didn't you?
lines.style: Playful accusation, eyes bright. Quick attack on his name. Leans in slightly, testing whether he'll admit to noticing her noticing him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、隣のクラスの小嶋と話してたな、桜
lines.en: You were talking to Kojima from the next class over, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Caught red-handed but turning it back on her. Calm, almost amused. A small smile in the voice—he saw her watching. Measured delivery, no heat.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で千葉県佐原の祭り行ったろ
lines.en: Riku—your family went to the festival in Sawara, Chiba. I know you did.
lines.style: Pressing her point, a little more direct. Still teasing but with an edge of 'I know things about you.' Voice stays light but the rhythm is faster, more insistent.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、東京文京区の中学に通ってたよな、桜
lines.en: You went to that junior high school in Bunkyo, Tokyo, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Mirror her rhythm back to her. Voice even, almost deadpan. He's not backing down—he knows things too. The 'Sakura' at the end lands like a gentle point scored.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、漫画の原画展に並んでたな
lines.en: Riku—you stood in line for that manga original artwork exhibition.
lines.style: Softer now, less accusatory. A real observation, almost vulnerable underneath the teasing. Pause before the last phrase. She's showing him she knows what he actually cares about.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、音楽で沢田研二の曲習ったろ、桜
lines.en: You learned songs by Kenji Sawada in music class, remember? Sawada Kenji.
lines.style: Gentle, almost sing-song. Less confrontational now—this feels like they're sharing something. His voice carries a hint of tenderness, admitting that he knows her tastes too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、クイック家事って言葉気に入ってたな
lines.en: Riku—you actually liked that phrase, didn't you? 'Quick housework.'
lines.style: Wry half-smile in the voice. Softer sarcasm, not sharp. A little self-aware about how specific this is, how much attention it shows. Slight trailing edge, like she's caught herself being too knowing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭で壇上に上がってスピーチしたろ、桜
lines.en: You got up on stage at the culture festival and gave a speech, Sakura. You did.
lines.style: Quiet admiration underneath. Slower pace, steady eye-contact in the voice. Not teasing anymore—this is real recognition. The 'Sakura' lands with warmth, like he's saying: I saw you be brave.
